verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's API overview tells users to "import the spec into your favorite API tool, such as Postman," which points to a published, machine-readable API specification. A pre-built Postman collection backs this up. missing for 10: explicit naming of the spec format (OpenAPI/JSON/YAML), a documented download URL or versioning details, independent or hands-on corroboration of retrieving the spec.
